result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new matches, so they are unchecked. The `codeanalyzer` module tests ran with no failures in the output I saw.

- **Generated HTML:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `(html|htm|xhtml)`. Before, `html` was listed twice and `htm` was missing. The `.html` and `.xhtml` matches are unchanged.
- **Generated `.js` and `.xml`:** the `// Generated by …` rule now matches `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`. The `<doc>` rule now matches `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`. Both previously needed a file named exactly `.js` or `.xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` now qualify.
- **Gradle script:** the build-and-deployment rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. I did not touch the `build.gradle` rule.

The content patterns and line limits are unchanged. That is what keeps ordinary hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files out of the generated scope.
